name: Visionect sign
description: A Visionect e-paper sign (Place & Play 32", Joan, the 13" boards) driven directly, with no Visionect Software Suite. The sign dials the server address in its flash on TCP 11113; Tesserae listens there, renders a 16-level grey frame and pushes it over the sign's own protocol (pyvisionect). Point the sign at this host: run Tesserae where the old Visionect server ran, or set the address over the sign's USB console. The protocol has no authentication, so keep port 11113 on your LAN. Leave the UUID blank to bind the first unknown sign that connects within an hour. Quiet hours with sleep-through put the sign into deep sleep until the window ends.

uuid.label: Sign UUID
uuid.help: The sign's UUID, e.g. 36002000-1247-3830-3933-303600000000 (on the label, or in the old Visionect server's device list). Leave blank and the first unknown sign that connects within an hour of adding the device (or clearing this field) is bound to it; later ones are listed as discovered devices.
